native_context: Protected workflow transitions and business prerequisites
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Protected workflow transitions and business prerequisites — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Build the actual state graph, actor roles, prerequisites, approval content/version and commit boundary. Identify which transition protects a business invariant.
controls.controlled_verification: With an owned inert workflow compare the legitimate sequence with one skipped/reordered transition or content change after approval. Inspect whether the final consumer requires approval for the exact current object/version and whether errors leave partial committed state.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An API allowing direct transition is not insecure if equivalent prerequisites are enforced. A stale UI status does not prove stale approval authority; durable transition state is the oracle.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Validate actor, current state, prerequisites and approved version atomically at transition. Retest the original invalid sequence, legitimate sequence and rollback/retry behavior.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
